specialisms.name: Development economics
specialisms.desc: Why do living standards differ, and what changes them?
specialisms.question: Can a higher GDP miss improvements in well-being?
specialisms.answer: Yes. GDP tracks production, while well-being also depends on health, education, distribution and environmental quality.

specialisms.name: Behavioral economics
specialisms.desc: Explore the gap between tidy models and real decisions.
specialisms.question: Why might a default change participation?
specialisms.answer: People may stick with an existing option because of inertia, limited attention or the effort required to change it.

specialisms.name: Financial economics
specialisms.desc: Connect saving, uncertainty and the value of time.
specialisms.question: Does diversification remove every kind of risk?
specialisms.answer: No. Spreading holdings can reduce asset-specific risk, but broad market risks can still affect the portfolio.

specialisms.name: Industrial organization
specialisms.desc: Study strategy, market power and how industries work.
specialisms.question: Why do barriers to entry matter?
specialisms.answer: They can protect incumbent firms from competition, influencing prices, innovation and long-run profits.
